set.body: At the pinned eyesim revision, cover center, rescale, normalize, affine_transform and contract_transform with supplied and fitted transforms. Use non-square bounds and a held-out point so axis swaps, probability normalization and train-on-test leakage fail. Map results to Frame, Warp, Perspective and Scanpath.warp with explicit units and identities. Exit with generated reference fixtures, independent affine calculations, portable tests and documented unsupported fitted transforms.
set.title: Pin basic coordinate-transform conformance
